command.customattributes.disabled: Custom attributes are disabled on this server
command.customattributes.player_only: Only a player can open the attribute screen
customattributes.configuration.blacklist: Listed attributes are neither shown nor editable.
customattributes.configuration.default_r: Applied to attributes that have no override entry. Write [lower, upper] and the attribute is editable only while lower is smaller than upper; a reversed order disables it. Values outside the range are pushed back into it by the server. Wildcards: current (final value), base, default, min, max, inf; arithmetic and parentheses are supported, e.g. [min, current] or [current * 0.5, current].
customattributes.configuration.entries.t: One entry per line: "attribute_id=[lower, upper]". Example: minecraft:generic.movement_speed=[0, current]
customattributes.configuration.sync_inte: How often the server clamps out-of-range values back into their range and pushes value/range changes to players who keep the screen open.
